messages:
Sophie (CS): quick flag - multiple onboarding jobs hit intermittent timeouts this morning. need a short customer note + credit plan.
Ethan (Success Ops): can eng/sre confirm root cause + ETA? ill draft outbound.
Ravi (Eng): looks like a throttling edge case: coordinator dropped some parallel commit tokens during a brief burst. pushed a hotfix at 2025-03-04T09:40Z.
Clara (SRE): impact window ~09:20-09:45 UTC, error spike ~5.5%. we temporarily increased worker pool and suppressed retries; metrics stabilizing.
Ethan (Success Ops): draft message (short): "Hi — we experienced intermittent onboarding timeouts affecting some tenants earlier today. Status: hotfix deployed and canary monitoring underway. Next: full rollout if stable within 24–48h. Compensation: a one-time onboarding credit will be applied automatically to affected tenants. Office hours: 30m Q&A tomorrow; recording will be posted. Support: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-help"
Sophie (CS): good. change "one-time onboarding credit" to "one-time onboarding credit (applied automatically)" and add note that high-touch customers will get a personalized follow-up.
Ethan (Success Ops): updated. product okayed credit policy; ops to apply credits within 48h.
Ravi (Eng): action items for RCA: 1) add guard to token allocation 2) synthetic load test for commit bursts 3) instrument dropped-token metric.
Clara (SRE): SRE items: dashboard for affected tenants, alert if dropped-token rate >1% sustained, 72h runbook checks after rollout.
Sophie (CS): who hosts office hours?
Ethan (Success Ops): ill host CS side, Ravi and Clara join for tech Q&A. OpsBot create event and incident.
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2025-0421. Event: "Onboard timeouts Q&A" — 2025-03-05T14:00:00Z. Recording will be attached to the incident.
Sophie (CS): please DM me the list of affected high-touch tenants so renewals can do outreach.
Ethan (Success Ops): will DM the list. legal will do a quick check before outbound send; target EOD.
Ravi (Eng): :white_check_mark:
Clara (SRE): :white_check_mark:
Sophie (CS): closing thread for now — will reopen with RCA + recording after office hours.
